title: Java Optional Patterns
description: Practice high-frequency Java Optional null-safety patterns for backend code.

steps.title: Wrap nullable value
steps.instruction: Type the Optional wrapper for a nullable getter.
steps.targetCode: Optional<String> name = Optional.ofNullable(user.getName());

steps.title: Fallback value
steps.instruction: Type the Optional fallback pattern.
steps.hint: Use orElse for the default string.
steps.targetCode: String label = Optional.ofNullable(order.getLabel()).orElse("draft");

steps.title: Throw when missing
steps.instruction: Type the repository lookup with an exception fallback.
steps.targetCode: User user = userRepository.findById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new NotFoundException("user"));

steps.title: Filter then act
steps.instruction: Type the Optional filter and callback pattern.
steps.targetCode: Optional.ofNullable(email).filter(e -> e.contains("@")).ifPresent(this::sendWelcome);

steps.title: Map nested property
steps.instruction: Type the null-safe nested property lookup.
steps.targetCode: String city = Optional.ofNullable(user).map(User::getAddress).map(Address::getCity).orElse("Unknown");
steps.encouragement: Nested access without a null check.

steps.title: Map to size
steps.instruction: Type the Optional size extraction pattern.
steps.hint: Map to items, then map to size.
steps.targetCode: int total = Optional.ofNullable(cart).map(Cart::items).map(List::size).orElse(0);

steps.title: Trim and reject blank
steps.instruction: Type the normalized Optional return.
steps.hint: Trim first, then filter empty strings.
steps.targetCode: return Optional.ofNullable(token).map(String::trim).filter(s -> !s.isEmpty());

steps.title: Filter by enum
steps.instruction: Type the Optional enum filter.
steps.targetCode: Optional<Order> paid = order.filter(o -> o.status() == Status.PAID);

steps.title: Boolean default
steps.instruction: Type the Optional boolean fallback.
steps.hint: Map to the boolean getter and default to false.
steps.targetCode: boolean active = Optional.ofNullable(user).map(User::isActive).orElse(false);

steps.title: Apply optional limit
steps.instruction: Type the Optional command callback.
steps.hint: Pass the method reference to ifPresent.
steps.targetCode: Optional.ofNullable(request.getLimit()).ifPresent(query::limit);

steps.title: Require present value
steps.instruction: Type the required product SKU extraction.
steps.hint: Use Optional.of when null should fail fast.
steps.targetCode: String sku = Optional.of(product).map(Product::sku).orElseThrow();

steps.title: Flat map repository
steps.instruction: Type the Optional flatMap repository lookup.
steps.hint: Use flatMap when the repository already returns Optional.
steps.targetCode: Optional<Customer> customer = Optional.ofNullable(dto.customerId()).flatMap(customerRepo::findById);
